title: Game card
summary: The card in the timeline for one game. A duel card waits for both players, then shows both picks and the winner with a short animation. A roll card animates and lands on the same values on every phone.

gameId.description: From the challenge or roll step.

phase.description: waiting: a commit or answer is missing. revealing: all commits are in and a reveal is missing. done: the result is known. verifyFailed: a reveal does not match its commit (checkReveal).

isPlayer.description: true when this account is the challenger or the opponent of a duel.

ownPickMade.description: true when this account sent its commit.

challengerPick.description: After the reveal: a number or a hand.

rollValues.description: From rollValues(gameId, senderSeed, answerSeed, sides, count).

outcome.description: For soccer, basketball and darts: rollOutcome of the single value.

choice.description: A number minNumber to maxNumber as a decimal string, or pedra, papel or tesoura.

pick.effect: Makes a salt of saltBytes and sends a commit step with gameCommit(gameId, ownUserId, choice, salt). Keeps the choice and salt on this phone. Shows bipe_games_chosen.

reveal.effect: Automatic, no tap. When both commits of a duel are in the timeline, the phone sends a reveal step with its choice and salt. For a roll, when the first answer is in the timeline, the sender's phone sends a reveal step with its seed.

answer.effect: Automatic, no tap. The first phone of another member that sees a roll with no answer yet sends an answer step with a fresh random seed of seedBytes in clear. Every phone uses the first answer in timeline order and ignores later ones.

decline.effect: The opponent sends a decline step. The card shows bipe_games_declined.

playAgain.effect: Starts a new game of the same kind with the same people and reason.

notes: A duel expires after duelExpirySeconds without both commits. A roll shows bipe_games_not_revealed when the sender's phone does not reveal within rollRevealTimeoutSeconds after the answer.
A d2 with one die shows bipe_games_coin_heads for 1 and bipe_games_coin_tails for 2.
Several dice: the card shows each value and bipe_games_dice_total.
Par ou ímpar shows bipe_games_sum and bipe_games_result_par or bipe_games_result_impar.
The phone checks every reveal with checkReveal before it shows a result. A failed check shows bipe_games_verify_failed and no winner.
Only the players' phones send commits and reveals. Other members of a group watch the card.
Limit: a person who controls two accounts in the same chat can choose a roll result.
